name: ag2-functions
description: AG2's one Cloud Function: readDeadlines, which fetches a student's Blackboard calendar at the private link they paste (index.js). Deployed on its own with firebase deploy --only functions; checked by scripts/check-deadlines.mjs.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check lib/read-deadlines.js && node --check shared/calendar-link.js && node --check shared/calendar-feed.js && node --check shared/access-gate.js
